Jane — thanks for the note. Short answer: our standard policy is economy for flights under 6 hours and business on flights 6+ hours or for senior leadership exceptions. That said, we are open to a policy exception here for the two ACME execs given their seniority and tight schedule.

To move forward we need: 
- A cost delta estimate (economy vs business) for both travelers.
- Written confirmation from ACME that the execs will attend in person (I see that from your calendar invite but procurement wants the attendee names).
- Internal POC for invoicing (we usually bill travel to the event budget; please confirm if ACME will reimburse travel or Redwood should absorb and invoice).

Monica — can you run a quick quote and flag any early-bird fare constraints? Laura, tagging for budget/GL code. Vivek — I can approve an exception up to $6k total for flights; if it's above that I'll need a quick escalation to ops director.

Thanks — Marissa
